title: The Weather Today and Tomorrow
text:
Today the weather is cold and windy. The sky is grey, and it is raining a little. Yesterday it was sunny and warm. We went to the park and played football.

Tomorrow the weather will be better. The sun will come out in the morning. It will be warm again. Many people like sunny days.

questions.text: What is the weather like today?
What will the weather be like in the morning tomorrow?
Why did the writer probably feel happy yesterday?
What can we guess about how the writer feels about tomorrow?

vocabulary.definition: not cold, but not very hot

paragraph_translations: Сьогодні погода холодна і вітряна. Небо сіре, і трохи йде дощ. Вчора було сонячно і тепло. Ми пішли в парк і грали у футбол.
Завтра погода буде кращою. Вранці вийде сонце. Знову буде тепло. Багатьом людям подобаються сонячні дні.
